notes: Resolves the caller with me(), then calls POST /api/v1/jwt/sign (secret MERC_CHAT_API_KEY) with user {id, display_name} and metadata {merc_uid, merc_org, merc_exp, merc_sig = HMAC-SHA256(MERC_INTERNAL_CALL_KEY, 'uid|org|exp')}. The Rep app passes the token to createChat. Buddy tools read the claims from communication.metadata and verify merc_sig (shared/core me.ts). TTL 60 min; the app refreshes.
